subject: Re: Northbridge Analytics — request for rollback + audit trail commitments (Optimize)
body:
From: Ava Chen <ava.chen@redwoodinference.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwoodinference.com>, Dr. Aisha Rahman <aisha.rahman@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, Dec 3, 2025 at 9:12 AM PST
Subject: Northbridge Analytics — request for rollback + audit trail commitments (Optimize)

Marissa —

Northbridge is moving into security/procurement review for Optimize (Dedicated). They’re pushing hard on “safe apply / rollback” for optimization config changes (batching + caching toggles + quant profiles) as a blocker.

Their CTO (James) asked for two explicit commitments we can put in the mutual action plan:
1) One-click rollback to a known-good optimization config version, ideally from the Console.
2) Audit trail: who changed what, when, what scope (tenant/model/region), and evidence it was applied/rolled back.

Two questions:
- What’s the most accurate roadmap timing to share? (They’re trying to lock the pilot start date in January.)
- What can we credibly say exists today vs. “coming soon” without overcommitting?

Attaching their questionnaire + a 1-pager they sent on expected controls.

Thanks,
Ava
—
Ava Chen
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference

Attachment: Northbridge_Security_Questionnaire_v3.xlsx
Attachment: Northbridge_Rollback_Requirements_Summary.pdf


From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Ava Chen <ava.chen@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwoodinference.com>, Dr. Aisha Rahman <aisha.rahman@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, Dec 3, 2025 at 10:01 AM PST
Subject: Re: Northbridge Analytics — request for rollback + audit trail commitments (Optimize)

Ava —

This is aligned with what we’re building (safe apply + rollback + audit + RBAC). I want to be careful on dates.

What we can say (accurate):
- We are implementing versioned “Optimization Config” objects in the control plane with immutable versions + metadata and a diff view.
- Safe apply will support staged rollout (scope tenant/model/region; optional canary %) gated on health signals (5xx + p95/p99 latency). Quant profile changes will additionally be gated on eval signals.
- Rollback will be a single action in Console and via API to revert to a prior version; runtime applier will be idempotent and safe under retries.
- Audit logging is part of the same release: create/validate/apply/promote/rollback events with actor + request ID + scope.

Timing guidance for sales:
- Target: internal beta in January (feature-flagged), limited GA Feb–Mar for selected Hosted/Dedicated accounts.
- For a January pilot, we can offer a controlled rollout with our team operating the change + rollback via internal tooling/runbook, but I would not promise “one-click in Console for customer admins” in January.

How to position “today”:
- Today: we can do rollbacks operationally (SRE-assisted) and we have existing change logs at the service level, but not end-to-end, customer-visible version history + one-click rollback with the right audit artifacts.
- Coming: customer-visible change history + rollback, plus formal audit event taxonomy.

Connor/Aisha — please sanity check the phrasing on beta/GA and audit log claims.

Marissa
—
Marissa Cole
Director of Product, Redwood Inference


From: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwoodinference.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Ava Chen <ava.chen@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Dr. Aisha Rahman <aisha.rahman@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, Dec 3, 2025 at 10:18 AM PST
Subject: Re: Northbridge Analytics — request for rollback + audit trail commitments (Optimize)

+1 to Marissa’s framing.

Release-wise: we can commit to “internal beta in Jan” only if we keep it explicitly feature-flagged and Redwood-operated for early accounts. Customer-admin UI access should stay “Feb+” to avoid a timeline mismatch with Console and runtime landing together.

Also recommend we avoid “SLA” language for rollback speed in sales emails (at least until Limited GA criteria is met).

— Connor


From: Dr. Aisha Rahman <aisha.rahman@redwoodinference.com>
To: Ava Chen <ava.chen@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, Dec 3, 2025 at 10:37 AM PST
Subject: Re: Northbridge Analytics — request for rollback + audit trail commitments (Optimize)

Agree with the above.

For audit trail commitments, please keep it to:
- “We generate structured audit events for create/apply/promote/rollback of optimization configuration changes.”
- “Events include actor identity, timestamp, scope, config version IDs, and request correlation IDs.”

Avoid committing to exact retention duration in this email thread unless James asks; we can provide it in the security response where we can be precise and consistent with our enterprise defaults.

— Aisha
Dr. Aisha Rahman
CISO, Redwood Inference


From: Ava Chen <ava.chen@redwoodinference.com>
To: James Whitaker <james.whitaker@northbridgeanalytics.com>
Cc: Priya Deshmukh <priya.deshmukh@northbridgeanalytics.com>
Date: Wed, Dec 3, 2025 at 11:06 AM PST
Subject: Re: Northbridge Analytics — request for rollback + audit trail commitments (Optimize)

James —

Thanks for calling this out. This is an active product area for us and it’s aligned with what you’re asking for.

Here’s what we can commit to on our roadmap:
- Versioned optimization configs (immutable versions + metadata + diff view).
- Safe apply with staged rollout (by tenant/model/region; optional canary %) gated on service health signals (error rate + p95/p99 latency). For quantization profile changes, we also gate on eval/quality signals.
- Rollback will be supported as a single action in the Console and via API to revert to a prior known-good config version.
- Audit trail: structured audit events for create/apply/promote/rollback with actor identity, timestamp, scope, and request correlation IDs.

Timing: we’re targeting an internal, feature-flagged beta in January (Redwood-operated for early accounts), with limited general availability for selected Dedicated/Hosted customers in Feb–Mar.

If it helps, for your January pilot window we can include Redwood-operated rollout/rollback as part of the engagement, and then transition you to the customer-admin UI once enabled.

Let me know if you want to do a 20-min working session with Priya to map these to your control requirements.

Best,
Ava


From: James Whitaker <james.whitaker@northbridgeanalytics.com>
To: Ava Chen <ava.chen@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Priya Deshmukh <priya.deshmukh@northbridgeanalytics.com>
Date: Thu, Dec 4, 2025 at 9:44 AM PST
Subject: Re: Northbridge Analytics — request for rollback + audit trail commitments (Optimize)

Ava —

This is helpful.

Two follow-ups so we can clear procurement:

1) Audit log details: can you confirm the audit event includes “before/after” (or at least a diff) and the effective scope (model + region), and that it covers rollbacks as a first-class event (not just “apply”)?

2) Retention/export: what’s the default retention for these audit events, and is there an option to export to our SIEM? (We’re standardizing on Splunk.)

On timing: we can accept “Redwood-operated” in January, but we’ll need it documented in the MAP as a control and we’ll want an ETA for when the customer-admin one-click is available.

Thanks,
James

—
James Whitaker
CTO, Northbridge Analytics


From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Ava Chen <ava.chen@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Dr. Aisha Rahman <aisha.rahman@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, Dec 4, 2025 at 11:26 AM PST
Subject: Re: Northbridge Analytics — request for rollback + audit trail commitments (Optimize)

Ava —

Approved answers (keep concise):

1) Audit events
- Yes, rollback is a first-class audit event (distinct from apply/promote).
- Events include the effective scope (tenant/model/region) and both “from_version” and “to_version”.
- We will also provide a diff view in Console; for audit export we will include version references (and a stable way to fetch the diff by version IDs).

2) Retention/export
- Don’t guess retention in email. Offer to provide in the security questionnaire response (Aisha team will confirm the exact number).
- For SIEM: we support enterprise audit log export (we can say “SIEM-friendly structured export”, and we’ll confirm Splunk specifics with Security).

For MAP: write “Jan: Redwood-operated apply/rollback under feature flag; Feb–Mar: customer-admin Console + API self-service enabled for selected accounts.”

Marissa
